    • calcSurfaceTension

      public double calcSurfaceTension(int interface1, int interface2)
      Calculates the surface tension between two phases. Density-profile models log numerical failure before using Parachor for a gas interface or Firozabadi-Ramley for a liquid-liquid interface. A failed fallback raises an exception.
      Specified by:
      calcSurfaceTension in interface SurfaceTensionInterface
      Parameters:
      interface1 - Phase index 1
      interface2 - Phase index 2
      Returns:
      finite, nonnegative surface tension in N/m; zero when the system has no interface

    • validateInterface

      protected boolean validateInterface(int interface1, int interface2)
      Validates the active bulk phases before a model evaluates their interface.
      Parameters:
      interface1 - first phase index
      interface2 - second phase index
      Returns:
      false for a single-phase system, which retains the legacy zero/no-interface result
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the phase indices are inactive or identical
      IllegalStateException - if a bulk state is not finite and physical

    • getReferenceComponent

      protected int getReferenceComponent(int interface1, int interface2)
      Selects the component with the largest bulk density contrast for density-path integration. A trace high-boiling component can have almost identical densities in gas and oil in a three-phase fluid.
      Parameters:
      interface1 - first phase index
      interface2 - second phase index
      Returns:
      component index with the largest absolute molar-density contrast
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the bulk phases have no density contrast

    • correlationFallback

      protected double correlationFallback(int interface1, int interface2, RuntimeException failure)
      Provides a documented correlation result when a density-profile solver fails.
      Parameters:
      interface1 - first phase index
      interface2 - second phase index
      failure - reason the selected model failed
      Returns:
      validated Parachor tension for gas interfaces or Firozabadi-Ramley tension for liquid interfaces, in N/m
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the correlation also cannot produce a valid result
